approach: Rewrite `pr_commits` to walk remote_base..head oldest first and classify each commit from its diff against its first parent, never reading messages. Order: (1) fingerprint(git, sha, parent) equals fingerprint(git, parent, parent) -> records_only; (2) an added records/interventions/<month>/<id>.json -> declared_intervention; (3) one job's candidate.json, verification.json and outcome(.json or -landed.json) all added under records/jobs/<month>/<job>/ -> job_landing with job and verification_id(job, sha); (4) otherwise bail naming the sha. Share path parsing with the gate via two pure pub helpers in invariant.rs. PrCommit becomes {sha, tree, kind, job, verification}; gh.rs commits() passes them through. Replace trailer tests, update docs and changelog.

decisions.choice: Classify from git.diff_tree(first_parent, sha) plus fingerprint; do not build gate Change/Judged objects.
decisions.reason: pr_commits has only git and shas; added paths are all the content rules need. The gate still validates deeply when it gates the landing commit.

rejected.why: Needs Change and Judged and validates more than classification, widening coupling.

decisions.choice: Expose closing_record_of_path and intervention_of_path from invariant.rs and reuse them in the gate and land.rs.
decisions.reason: One definition of the path rules; pure refactor, no gate behavior change.

rejected.why: It takes Change/Judged and loads files from a tree.

decisions.choice: job_landing requires candidate, verification and an outcome all added for exactly one job; otherwise refuse.
decisions.reason: Matches 'closing records' and the gate's landing case; partial sets must not be recorded as covered landings.

rejected.why: A partial set would be recorded as a landing.

decisions.choice: Compare with the first parent; root or merge commits in the range are refused with their sha.
decisions.reason: Range is expected to be linear.

rejected.why: Out of scope; gate merge rules differ.

files.purpose: Rewrite PrCommit and pr_commits to classify by content; new realistic-range, refusal, empty-range tests; remove trailer-count tests.
commits() passes kind, job and verification through; reshape test World so the work commit is a real job landing; hand-edit refusal test.
Add pub closing_record_of_path and intervention_of_path and use them in closing_jobs and intervention, with no behavior change.
Section 5.3 and the failure table row describe content classification instead of the one-trailer rule.
Unreleased Changed entry; fix the earlier line saying pr_commits is unchanged.

steps: In invariant.rs add pub closing_record_of_path and intervention_of_path; rewire closing_jobs and intervention; run cargo test -p athena-gate invariant.
In land.rs redefine PrCommit {sha, tree, kind, job, verification} and rewrite pr_commits per the check order; keep the empty-range error; refuse root/merge commits with the sha.
Write doc comments with the content rules; drop all Athena-Job text and unused imports.
Add land.rs tests: realistic range, refusal (including incomplete landing), empty range; remove trailer-count tests.
Update gh.rs commits() and the test World; assert kinds and validate; turn the trailer-missing test into a hand-edit refusal.
Run cargo test -p athena-core land::, gh::, cargo test -p athena-gate invariant, cargo clippy -p athena-core --all-targets, cargo fmt --check.

risks.risk: Closing-record file names differ from what the brief assumes.
risks.mitigation: Helper reuses the gate's CLOSING list, so both agree by construction.

risks.risk: The operator/ lease or reading commits are not fingerprint-neutral under default rules and get refused.
risks.mitigation: The test checks this; if false, report it instead of special-casing.

risks.risk: gh tests built around trailer-only commits now get refused.
risks.mitigation: Run gh:: tests and reshape fixtures to content.

risks.risk: Two fingerprint calls per commit are slow on long ranges.
risks.mitigation: Reuse the previous commit's fingerprint as the next parent's where simple.

risks.risk: Editing invariant.rs could change gate behavior.
risks.mitigation: Helpers only move existing parsing; run cargo test -p athena-gate invariant.

demonstrations.method: Unit test in land.rs builds a repo: base, then plain-message commits: reading, dispatch, introspection record commits, a lease file under operator/, an intervention adding records/interventions/<month>/<id>.json, then a landing adding a governed file plus the job's candidate, verification and outcome records. Calls pr_commits.
demonstrations.observes: Test passes; kinds in order are RecordsOnly x4, DeclaredIntervention, JobLanding with job equal to the job id and verification equal to verification_id(job, sha); no message has an Athena-Job trailer.
demonstrations.fails_without: The old trailer logic errors on the first commit; a missing fingerprint, intervention or closing-records rule gives different kinds or an error.

demonstrations.method: Unit test adds a plain-message commit changing a governed file with no intervention or closing records (plus a variant landing missing its verification record) and calls pr_commits.
demonstrations.observes: Err whose text contains the offending commit's full sha.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the fallback classified such a commit or the error omitted the sha, the contains(sha) assertion fails.

demonstrations.method: Reshape the gh test World so its work commit is a real job landing; assert recorded Landing commits carry the kind from pr_commits and that LandingCommit::validate passes; the hand-edit test is refused with its sha, nothing recorded, zero merges.
demonstrations.observes: All gh tests pass with kind JobLanding plus job and verification on the written commits.
demonstrations.fails_without: If gh.rs still hard-coded JobLanding or dropped job/verification, kind assertions or validation fail.

demonstrations.observes: PrCommit has kind, job: Option<JobId>, verification: Option<RecordId>; pr_commits and PrCommit have no trailers( call and no Athena-Job text; doc comments state the content rules and refusal.

demonstrations.method: The classification test plus an empty-range assertion pr_commits(git, head, head); code uses fingerprint(git, sha, parent) == fingerprint(git, parent, parent), the same function first_governed_change uses.
demonstrations.observes: Empty range returns the 'adds no commit' error; an operator/-and-records/-only commit is RecordsOnly; a governed change is not.
demonstrations.fails_without: A different rules argument or wrong parent would misclassify the operator/ lease commit and fail the criterion 1 test.

demonstrations.method: Remove the trailer-count pr_commits tests and the gh 'lies between the remote base and the PR head' trailer test; view test names in the run output.
demonstrations.observes: New test names run and none of the old ones; remaining Athena-Job strings in land.rs are only the unrelated resync_tip test messages.
demonstrations.fails_without: Leftover trailer tests would still run and fail against content-based behavior.

demonstrations.method: Run clippy, then cargo fmt --check, on the finished tree. A lint failure is the deliberate signal: unused imports (Context, JobId, trailers helpers) left after removing trailer code, or unformatted new code, make these commands fail.
demonstrations.observes: Clippy reports no warnings and cargo fmt --check prints no diff and exits 0.
demonstrations.fails_without: Leftover unused trailer imports or helper code, or unformatted new tests, would produce clippy warnings or an fmt diff and fail the command.

open_questions: Whether the default classification treats operator/ as non-governed; the lease-commit test will show it, and the producer must report rather than special-case.
Whether a job's verification id always equals verification_id(job, sha); relied on the existing function.
Whether a landing that adds only outcome-landed.json with candidate and verification should be accepted; plan accepts it as the gate does.
